character: Historic, undulating British circuit with dramatic elevation change through the Craner Curves. Technical and flowing in equal measure — rewards precision and confidence over blind crests.

corners.name: Redgate
corners.technique: Firm braking from the start/finish straight, late apex to set up the downhill run
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the entry to the Craner Curves

corners.name: Craner Curves
corners.technique: Commit through the downhill esses with smooth, minimal steering
corners.trap: Braking or lifting mid-sequence unsettles the car on the downhill camber

corners.name: Old Hairpin
corners.type: tight, slow corner at the bottom of the hill
corners.technique: Hard braking after the fast downhill section, patient throttle on exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed from Craner Curves and missing the braking point

corners.name: McLeans
corners.technique: Commit through the uphill corner, smooth steering
corners.trap: Lifting on the uphill entry kills exit speed

corners.name: Coppice
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the run to the line
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs time down the entire straight
